records.title: Triformer: Triangular, Variable-Specific Attentions for Long Sequence Multivariate Time Series Forecasting-Full Version
records.reason: Triformer replaces quadratic sequence attention with linear-complexity patch attention and a shrinking triangular stack, while explicitly preserving efficiency and memory usage.

records.title: FECAM: Frequency Enhanced Channel Attention Mechanism for Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: FECAM improves time-series forecasting metrics through frequency-aware channel attention but explicitly incurs a slight computational cost; the abstract does not support an efficiency benefit for inference or serving.

records.title: DIFFormer: Scalable (Graph) Transformers Induced by Energy Constrained Diffusion
records.reason: DIFFormer provides a linear-complexity graph-transformer encoder for prohibitive instance counts. The abstract supplies a concrete scaling property in attention-based encoders that can transfer to large-model sequence systems.

records.title: Structured State Space Models for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The S4-based architecture is explicitly described as fast at inference, asymptotically faster than Transformers by sequence length, and over five times faster in tested environments.

records.title: SparseFusion: Fusing Multi-Modal Sparse Representations for Multi-Sensor 3D Object Detection
records.reason: The title is a multi-sensor 3D object-detection application and states no inference-systems efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Diffusion models for time-series applications: a survey
records.reason: The title is a broad survey of diffusion models for time-series applications, not a specific inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Diffusion Models for Imperceptible and Transferable Adversarial Attack
records.reason: The title is an adversarial-attack method, not an inference runtime or resource-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation (DUDE)
records.reason: The title identifies a document-understanding dataset and evaluation benchmark, not a model-inference or serving-efficiency method.

records.title: XuanYuan 2.0: A Large Chinese Financial Chat Model with Hundreds of Billions Parameters
records.reason: The title describes a domain-specific financial chat-model release, without a stated inference-efficiency or serving contribution.

records.title: DSformer: A Double Sampling Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Long-term Prediction
records.reason: DSformer combines double sampling and temporal-variable attention for forecast accuracy; the abstract provides no measured reduction in computation, memory, latency, or model serving cost.

records.title: InfiAgent-DABench: Evaluating Agents on Data Analysis Tasks
records.reason: The title is a benchmark for data-analysis agents, with no stated model-serving or inference-efficiency method.

records.title: AttnLRP: Attention-Aware Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for Transformers
records.reason: The title is a relevance-propagation explainability method for Transformers, not an inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: CALF: Aligning LLMs for Time Series Forecasting via Cross-modal Fine-Tuning
records.reason: The title explicitly describes cross-modal fine-tuning for time-series forecasting, a training adaptation rather than inference-system efficiency.

records.title: VM-UNET-V2 Rethinking Vision Mamba UNet for Medical Image Segmentation
records.reason: The title identifies medical-image segmentation as the application, with no stated inference-systems or transferable efficiency mechanism.

records.title: TimeMachine: A Time Series is Worth 4 Mambas for Long-Term Forecasting
records.reason: TimeMachine uses Mamba sequence modeling and explicitly claims linear scalability and small memory footprints. This is a concrete, transferable state-space efficiency technique for long-sequence model execution.

records.title: BioMedLM: A 2.7B Parameter Language Model Trained On Biomedical Text
records.reason: BioMedLM demonstrates a 2.7B autoregressive model as an economical alternative to much larger computationally expensive models for biomedical NLP, a concrete domain-specific inference-cost reduction.

records.title: Stream of Search (SoS): Learning to Search in Language
records.reason: Stream of Search trains language models to reason over symbolic-search traces and reports accuracy gains; no computational or runtime efficiency contribution is claimed.

records.title: Continual Pre-Training for Cross-Lingual LLM Adaptation: Enhancing Japanese Language Capabilities
records.reason: The title explicitly studies continual pre-training for language adaptation, a training objective rather than systems efficiency.

records.title: CycleResearcher: Improving Automated Research via Automated Review
records.reason: The title targets automated research and review quality, not model-serving efficiency or runtime systems.

records.title: Task Singular Vectors: Reducing Task Interference in Model Merging
records.reason: TSV-Compress retains 99% accuracy while reducing task-layer matrix size to 10%; this is a concrete model compression method with direct storage/runtime relevance and is combined with model merging.
